codebase-memory.activation: Structural codebase discovery, tracing, or impact analysis.

diagnosis.activation: A reproducible bug, failed check, or unexpected behavior.

regression-testing.activation: A behavior change or repair with a meaningful observable regression.

verification.activation: A distinct verification assignment or uncertain completion evidence.

design.activation: New interfaces or substantial visual or interaction decisions.

accessibility.activation: Changed interactive UI or an explicitly requested accessibility review.

react.activation: React or Next.js code with relevant rendering, fetching, or performance concerns.

grilling.activation: Consequential product or scope decisions remain unresolved after research and a deeper interview would help.
grilling.availability: optional; use only if independently installed and discoverable

systematic-debugging.activation: A difficult reproducible failure needs deeper root-cause investigation.
systematic-debugging.availability: optional; use only if independently installed and discoverable

frontend-design.activation: A substantial interface design needs specialist visual direction.
frontend-design.availability: optional; use only if independently installed and discoverable

react-best-practices.activation: React or Next.js rendering, fetching, or performance concerns need deeper specialist guidance.
react-best-practices.availability: optional; use only if independently installed and discoverable
